notes:
A big one: a new video engine, and the app catches up with the desktop.

- **Videos that wouldn't play now play.** The app now uses the same video engine
  as the desktop app (mpv). It no longer depends on what your phone's chip can
  decode, so 10-bit anime, DTS/TrueHD audio and the rest play everywhere — and
  styled anime subtitles look the way they should.
- **Player extras.** Press and hold the video to watch at 2×, ±10 second
  buttons, a proper speed menu, load a subtitle file from your device, subtitles
  already on the server show up in the menu, and search for subtitles online
  right from the player. Movies ask for a rating when they finish.
- **Continue watching, done properly.** One card per episode you're part-way
  through plus "next up" for shows you're bingeing — tap to play straight away,
  ✕ to clear or hide a card. Your progress percentages are also fixed: shows you
  were part-way through weren't being recognised as in progress.
- **Title pages like the desktop.** Mark a whole season watched, see runtimes,
  the cast, the rest of a movie's series ("Find it" for the ones you don't have)
  and the trailer. If you're allowed to, edit a title's or an episode's info and
  pictures.
- **Collections and Watch Later.** Add titles or single episodes to
  collections (private ones too), manage them, and keep a personal Watch Later
  list with its own page. New downloads can go straight into a collection
  (Add media → Advanced options).
- **Ratings, rebuilt.** The Ratings page now lists what's in your library —
  movies and series with whole-series and per-season scores — shows everyone's
  scores before you rate, and Home asks you to rate what you just finished.
- **Libraries:** Cartoons and Collections sections, newest-first sorting, an age
  filter, and a gold medal on everything you've finished.
- **New pages:** Find something to watch (AI picks by type and genre), and
  Suggestions / Fixes to send ideas and bug reports.
- **And:** create an account from the sign-in page, your profile name and
  picture, a heads-up when you add something you already have, and the release
  notes in Settings after each update.

---
Installed apps update themselves: open Unseen Media and accept the update prompt, or use Settings → Updates → Check now.
